methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 widely-searched table tennis tables spanning entry-level rollaways (MD Sports, JOOLA Inside/Rally), mid-tier indoor club tables (Stiga Advantage/ST3100, Butterfly Easifold/Playback, Killerspin MyT7), and all-weather outdoor/crossover tables (Stiga XTR, JOOLA Nova, Cornilleau 250S/500M). All 12 SKUs were independently re-verified on 2026-08-16 against live manufacturer stores (stigaus.com, joola.com, shop.butterflyonline.com, medalsports.com) where the exact SKU is still sold, and against major specialty retailers/long-running review outlets (Conte Sales, Gameroomshop, EquipmentJunkie, ExpertTableTennis, PingPongRuler, BestOutdoorPingPongTables, PingPongTableReviews) when the manufacturer had renamed or discontinued the requested SKU; each such case is flagged in that product's provenance. playing_surface_thickness_mm is a string carrying the unit (e.g. "15 mm"); assembled_weight_lb is a unitless number; indoor_or_outdoor is "Indoor", "Outdoor", or "Indoor/Outdoor"; all other keys are booleans, with null used whenever a spec could not be confirmed on a live source rather than inferred by analogy. tournament_regulation_size reflects the ITTF-standard 108x60x30 in table footprint only, NOT top thickness or competition class: every full-size table here is therefore marked true, including Cornilleau's thin resin-top outdoor models (the draft's earlier 'FFTT leisure/C-class' false-flag for the Cornilleau tables conflated tournament sanctioning with physical footprint and treated them inconsistently versus the equally-thin 6mm Stiga XTR, so it was corrected to true). Fact-check pass also recovered assembled_weight_lb for the Cornilleau 500M (170 lb, stated in its retailer review) and nulled the MD Sports caster-lock spec as unconfirmable on the live manufacturer page. accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: Stiga Advantage
products.priceNote: MSRP per stigaus.com; site currently discounts to $499.99.
products.provenance: Verified directly on STIGA's official US store (fetched 2026-08-16): 15mm top, 198lb, Indoor, 3in lockable casters, 72in clipper net, 108x60x30in regulation footprint; page lists MSRP $549.99 discounted to $499.99. This is the base 15mm 'Advantage' SKU, distinct from the 'Advantage Lite' (12-13mm) and 'Advantage Pro' (18-19mm) variants some third-party listings conflate it with.

products.name: JOOLA Inside 15
products.priceNote: Current live retailer price ($650.00, listed out of stock at time of check); the ExpertTableTennis review cites a $349.99 launch-era figure. The two published USD prices could not be reconciled to a single authoritative source, so the current live-retailer figure is used and the discrepancy is flagged rather than guessed.
products.provenance: JOOLA's own site no longer hosts a live 'Inside 15' page, so verified via a live retailer listing plus a specialist review (both fetched 2026-08-16). CORRECTED: the retailer page states the top as 5/8in (rounded to 16mm) and gives NO weight; the 15mm/189lb figures and the USATT-approved claim come only from the ExpertTableTennis review, and the two sources diverge sharply on price ($650 live vs $349.99 review). 15mm is retained (matches the model name and the review) and 189lb is retained from the review; the retailer confirms dual locking casters and separate folding halves. Price and thickness are the soft points on this SKU.

products.name: JOOLA Rally TL
products.priceNote: MSRP for the 15mm base 'Rally TL 300' configuration per current specialty retailer/review (also the Amazon price); JOOLA's own site no longer lists this SKU.
products.provenance: JOOLA Rally TL no longer appears on joola.com's current lineup but remains a real, actively sold table via Amazon and specialty retailers. EquipmentJunkie review (fetched 2026-08-16) confirms $399.99, 15mm charcoal MDF top, 150lb (75lb per half), locking casters, playback and 108x60x30in footprint; a second review reports a close 155lb.

products.name: Killerspin MyT7
products.priceNote: MSRP for the 'BlackPocket' indoor rollaway configuration per Conte Sales; the independent review cites ~$850 for the standard MyT7 and ~$950 for the ClubPro trim.
products.provenance: The MyT7 no longer appears on Killerspin's official site (current indoor lineup is the MyT 415X series), so sourced from an authorized specialty dealer plus an independent review (both fetched 2026-08-16). Conte confirms $899 BlackPocket config, 18mm MDF top, regulation size; the review confirms 225lb and the 18mm top. Wheel-lock mechanism is not confirmed by either source, so wheels_with_lock is left null.

products.name: Cornilleau 250S Outdoor
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,200 per specialty retailer; frequently discounted to ~$900 (retailer sale price at time of check).
products.provenance: Cornilleau's US site no longer carries the '250S' name (current outdoor range uses 100X-700X naming), so verified across two independent specialty sources (both fetched 2026-08-16): BestOutdoor confirms $1,200 MSRP / $900 sale, 5mm laminate top; PingPongRuler confirms 141lb (64kg) and the 5mm top. CORRECTED: tournament_regulation_size changed false->true — the 250S is a full 108x60x30in table, and this field is defined by footprint, not top thickness or FFTT leisure/competition class (the draft's brand-specific false-flag was inconsistent with the 6mm Stiga XTR being marked true).
